metaphor: Genetically modified food is a hidden predator on your plate.
Coffee switches you on like a lightswitch.
Dove cream is a flower.
A sweet tooth is a predator chasing down your smile.
Strong hair gel has the grip of a lizard's feet.
Your smile is a row of bright lightbulbs.
Words can be deadly.
Your phone is a mouse trap.
A work boot is a heavy-duty bulldozer.
Failing to social distance is an explosion waiting to happen.
The canvas sails of a galleon ship are a swarm of vibrant butterflies.
The burger is a flame of flavour
My love is a summer day.
Anger is a demon that preys on the soul.
Autumn is a depression
Her hair is a rippling, tossing sea
Her hair is like the curling mist
My soul is a bird with broken wings.
The professor was a guiding light for him.
He wanted to set sail on the ocean of love but instead wasted away in the desert.
